internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Latency and Error Rate Spike
internal.body:
At 11:58 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate and increased latency. The p95 latency reached 1.2 seconds, exceeding the threshold, and error rates were around 10-12%. Initial diagnosis confirmed latency issues as the primary fault, supported by error injection evidence. Resource exhaustion was considered but not confirmed due to limited diagnostic data.

At 12:18 UTC, the flag causing the cart failure was disabled, which led to immediate recovery. Post-action verification showed stable latency at 0.12 seconds p95, confirming resolution.

Actions taken:
- Disabled the cartFailure flag to mitigate the issue.

The incident is resolved with no ongoing impact.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Issues Resolved
external.body: Between 11:58 and 12:18 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced delays and errors when using the cart service. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, restoring normal service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
